scripts.build: esbuild src/background.ts src/bridge.ts src/popup.ts src/content.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --format=esm --target=chrome100 && cp public/manifest.json public/popup.html public/popup.css public/demo-docdiff.json public/demo-filled.json public/demo-blocked.json dist/

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && esbuild src/verify-browser.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome100 --outfile=dist/verify-browser.js && node src/verify-dom.mjs && node src/verify-popup.mjs
